texts.preamble: Ganesh Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 24 January, 2025 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:13005 Court No. - 77 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 32266 of 2024 Applicant :- Ganesh Jaiswal Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Devesh Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J. 1.
texts.arguments: Contention of learned counsel for the application is that the from the perusal of the summoning order dated 17.5.2024, it is clear that while passing the same, the court below has not recorded Ganesh Jaiswal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 24 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25099439/ 1 satisfaction regarding making out prima facie case against the applicant. Therefore, the impugned order has been passed in complete non-application of mind. In support of his contention, learned counsel for the applicant has relied upon the judgement of the Apex Court in Sarif Ahmed and another vs. State of U.P. and another; 2024 SCC OnLine SC 726 in which the Apex Court has observed that though a detailed reasoning for summoning is not required to be mentioned in the order, but at least satisfaction of the Magistrate should be mentioned in the summoning order which is missing herein. 5. Learned A.G.A. though opposed the prayer but he could not dispute the aforesaid legal position.
